sentences.en: A rose by any other name would smell as sweet.
sentences.zh: 一个以其他名字出现的玫瑰同样会散发出甜美的香气。

sentences.en: A rose is sweeter in the bud than full blown.
sentences.zh: 含苞待放的玫瑰比完全盛开时更甜美。

sentences.en: Life has its sorrows, as every rose has its thorns.
sentences.zh: 生活有其悲伤，正如每一朵玫瑰都有刺。

phrases.zh: 关于玫瑰的,由玫瑰构成的

senses.zh: 玫瑰，蔷薇；玫瑰色，粉红色
